metadata.dcterms:title: A connection formula between the Ramanujan function and the q -Airy function
metadata.dcterms:creator: MORITA‡, Takeshi
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We show a connection formula between two diﬀerent q-Airy func- tions. One is called the Ramanujan function which appears in Ra- manujan’s ”Lost notebook”. Another one is called the q-Airy function that obtained in the study of the second q-Painlev´e equation. We use the q-Borel transformation and the q-Laplace transformation following C. Zhang to obtain the connection formula.
